messages:
Anna Li: Heads-up: our Go onboarding sample surfaced a plain 500 error during the demo. Users expect typed exceptions (ServerError/RateLimit) not opaque messages.

Samir Patel: Yeah saw that. Python & JS map 429 -> RateLimitError with retry_after. Go currently returns a generic error object which confuses devs.

Vikram Rao: Suggestion: standard mapping table in docs + SDKs by error_type header. Minimal mapping: 401/403 -> AuthError, 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable, include retry_after), 408/499 -> ClientTimeout, 5xx -> ServerError.

Lucy Chen: Also standardize user-facing wording. Replace "auth token invalid" with "Authentication failed 14 check your API key or refresh token." Include a correlation id in the error body for support.

Anna Li: Proposed HTTP error body shape to include in responses and examples:
```json
{ "error_type": "RateLimitError", "status": "429", "message": "Request rate exceeded", "retry_after": "2", "error_id": "abc-123" }
```

Samir Patel: I'll implement Go mapping and expose typed error types in the SDK surface. Will add migration note for any code that inspected only numeric status. Branch samir/err-typed-go, PR forthcoming.

ci-bot: CI passed for samir/err-typed-go 14 tests: 24 passed :white_check_mark:

Vikram Rao: For streaming: emit final error frame with same shape and error_id so sample apps can show partial outputs then final failure.

Lucy Chen: I'll update onboarding snippet and docs copy. Also add a tiny example for retry backoff using e.retry_after.

Anna Li: Great. Please link PR -> docs and add changelog entry: "SDK consistency: map HTTP error_type to typed exceptions and include retry hints and correlation id."

Samir Patel: Done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/128. Docs update linked.

Lucy Chen: :thumbsup: ready to ship
